gate_aggregation: Any demonstrated violation is fail; otherwise any missing required evidence is not_demonstrated; all seven passes permit human assessment, never automatic TRL assignment.

included: Local Windows software for read-only intake, declared simulation and offline replay
Input validation, clocks, paired channels, causal protocol processing and resource accounting
Durable results, recovery, authorization boundaries, API and native console
Demonstrated topology, terrestrial and satellite models, exclusive Map/Globe presentation
excluded_claims: Qualified physical quantum network or institutional operational deployment
Qualified instrument, optical terminal, RF reception or spacecraft control
Certified QKD security, production secret keys or quantum Internet connectivity
Universal learned-controller benefit, universal reach or universal simulation accuracy

sources.publication: NPR 7123.1D, Appendix E, updated with Change 2
sources.use: Software TRL 4/5 definitions; systems or simulations may represent the target environment.
Critical functions, relevant environment, scaling and independent assessment; guidance, not an OrionQ certification.

relevant_environment.type: Controlled local software environment with declared simulated or offline public-data origins

candidate_references.limits: Four-node chain, one source/destination; analytic twin calibrated by the author. This does not qualify all topology or protocol families.
Werner/reduced-state and ideal-operation assumptions; code-generated goldens alone do not establish independent physical agreement.
QBER/SKR coexistence effects only; platform-dependent magnitudes, no paired temporal WDM/Bell validation. Dataset permissions and publisher units must be respected.
Orbit predictions are not spacecraft housekeeping or payload; finite-block comparisons remain conditional on declared source and detection assumptions.

initial_baseline_protocol.purpose: Fresh diagnostic baseline; incomplete coverage cannot qualify the final performance gate.
does_not_demonstrate: Three full repetitions at both resolutions
All critical functions and reference domains

runtime.budget_origin: Existing runtime diagnostic budget; unchanged despite the 5.60.1 roadmap's 20/20 overruns.

native_ui.threshold_justification: Prospective engineering requirements: 100 ms for immediate interaction, 1 s for full detail usability, 50 ms for at least a 20 Hz presentation envelope, explicit tail and bounded-retention checks. These are not values mandated or guaranteed by NASA, ECSS, Qt or monitor refresh.

gates.name: scope_frozen
pass_criteria: Scope, critical functions, environment, seeds, limits and independent-reference admission plan frozen before scoring
Protocol/source/dependency/dataset/oracle hashes recorded and unchanged
Every excluded claim and dependency remains explicit
fail_criteria: Scope or acceptance threshold changed after observing results without a new revision
Missing or inconsistent recorded identity, or modified scored input
not_demonstrated_criteria: Freeze manifest or relevant-environment rationale is incomplete
gates.evidence_limits: A hash proves byte identity, not scientific accuracy, signatures or maturity.

gates.name: reference
pass_criteria: Every included critical function maps to an admitted independent reference or oracle with explicit domain, units, uncertainty and numeric acceptance interval
Current outputs meet the pre-frozen deterministic or equivalence tolerances across all required families
Dataset limitations and uncovered domains are disclosed and disjoint holdouts respected
fail_criteria: Training/calibration leakage, incompatible-unit pooling or unsupported claim is used to qualify a reference
not_demonstrated_criteria: Only code-generated goldens, same-plant replay or bounded subset coverage is available
Any required family lacks independently justified tolerances or admissible reference data
gates.evidence_limits: Published measurements or independent simulations qualify only the covered observables and conditions; no QBER-to-Bell conversion.

gates.name: pipeline
pass_criteria: Nominal/degraded/unavailable/recovery scenarios for every included family traverse the common input, validation, clock, protocol, resource, classical communication, durable receipt and backend presentation contracts
Equivalent simulated and replay observations preserve causal order, metrics, resource lineage and observation hashes
No-source, missing channel and incomplete observation produce explicit refusal rather than invented measurements
Optional ML remains off and physical actions/certified secret bits remain zero
fail_criteria: Injected final output bypasses observation processing
Contradictory backend/UI state, causal violation, fabricated success or boundary violation
not_demonstrated_criteria: A local fixture passes but not every required stage, family and source substitution is covered
API/UI trace or persistence linkage is absent
gates.evidence_limits: Passing local fixtures establishes only the exercised software flow, not physical devices or a live network.

gates.name: fault_recovery
pass_criteria: Faults are injected before/after admission, resource reservation/consumption, durable commit, receipt publication and response delivery
Restart/retry conserves committed event identity and explicit interrupted/uncertain states, with zero duplicated delivery or resource/key reuse
Invalid, stale, reordered, replayed and unauthorized observations are rejected or quarantined
Queue saturation accounts for rejected/dropped events, and unavailable physical conditions never become success
fail_criteria: Duplicate confirmed event, resurrected consumed/uncertain key or silent loss
Acquisition continues after uncertain configuration or revocation
not_demonstrated_criteria: Crash matrix, process independence, replay/authorization cases or conservation accounting lacks complete evidence
gates.evidence_limits: Local process/HTTP failures do not qualify power loss, damaged disks, hardware interlocks or institutional deployment.

gates.name: performance
pass_criteria: All prospective runtime and native UI thresholds pass in every full run on the recorded relevant environment
Full topology, all satellites/orbits, live telemetry/simulation and navigation are active
Source and frozen versions agree functionally; event order/precision/persistence are conserved
Required tail sample coverage, duration, swaps, soak and memory/resource checks are complete
fail_criteria: Freeze, content error, missed accepted operation, scientific event pruning or resource accumulation is observed
not_demonstrated_criteria: Only the short initial baseline or old reports are available
Required frame/tail/retention/CPU/GPU metadata or production coverage is missing
gates.evidence_limits: The earlier 20/20 10 ms runtime overruns remain unmet-budget evidence. A short baseline, heartbeat, preview or self-test cannot qualify FPS, tail latency or prolonged stability.

gates.name: reproduce
pass_criteria: A second isolated environment reconstructs the admitted source/dependencies/data and full campaign from documented commands
Seeds reproduce deterministic outputs or meet predeclared stochastic comparison intervals
Fresh output receipts, hashes, failure cases and dependency refusal are independently verified
Optional model archives and vendor SDKs are not silently substituted or required for the base product
fail_criteria: Recorded environment fails declared compatible inputs or reproduces different qualified outcomes beyond tolerance
Undocumented manual patch, credential or archive substitution is needed
not_demonstrated_criteria: Only the developer checkout, inherited dependencies or historical build is exercised
Second-environment dependencies/data/commands or required campaign coverage are absent
gates.evidence_limits: A second venv may validate installation reproducibility but does not by itself prove independent-machine, mixed-DPI or institutional acceptance.

gates.name: independent_review
pass_criteria: A named reviewer with relevant expertise outside the implementation team reviews the frozen scope, relevance, critical-function mapping, data/oracle independence and all results
Review binds to source/protocol/report hashes, states conflicts and unresolved discrepancies, and includes an explicit signed or otherwise authenticated conclusion
fail_criteria: Reviewer rejects scope relevance or evidence sufficiency
Undisclosed conflicts, altered evidence or unresolved critical discrepancy invalidate the assessment
not_demonstrated_criteria: No qualified independent reviewer or authenticated assessment is available
Only an automated checker, internal developer or AI-agent review exists
gates.evidence_limits: This is the project's chosen assessment requirement informed by ECSS guidance; passing software checks is not certification.
